result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming the build and deployment aspect no longer stops the export. I only compiled the `reports` module, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests or an export, so the renamed case hasn't been exercised.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the block that writes `all_files.zip`. It previously used five hard-coded names, such as `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. When the aspect was renamed, reading that file threw, which skipped both zips. It now loops over the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects, in that order. For each one it builds the file name with the same `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")` call that writes the loose text files. It then reads that file and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again, provided a `git-history.txt` exists.
